# UI game check

Stage `ui` explicitly. Open Settings and capture the code screen. Change Mode and Count, then press Y to request reset. The proof handles that request by restoring its two values; confirm both values change back. Change both again, move down to Finish, and press A. Read-only text must not take focus, and the content must scroll without a page number. Repeat for the data screen. Both render the same controls through the same stock widgets. Keep screenshots and the game log. Use physical controller input.

The Mods tab check is separate. Stage eight or more installed mods including a required provider and consumer and two containers that replace the same asset. Review and cancel an activation change, accept it, edit all six declared setting kinds, move a mod, and save. Restart the game. Check persisted activation and order, disabled containers, dependent blocking, and the later enabled container winner.
